items.title: BB fights on to curb family grip on banks
items.description: Bangladesh Bank has held its ground on curbing family control of private banks in a new reform proposal, resisting pressure from the country’s powerful bank owners.

items.title: Japanese firms warming up to Bangladesh
items.description: Japanese companies are increasingly looking to Bangladesh, attracted by its large consumer base, growing middle class and potential for investment.

items.title: Country’s only DAP fertiliser plant remains shut for 4 months
items.description: The country’s only diammonium phosphate (DAP) fertiliser factory has been shut for nearly four months due to a shortage of phosphoric acid -- a key raw material -- with a government approval delay holding up fresh imports.

items.title: ADP spending hits 17-year low in Q1
items.description: The government’s development spending in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 (FY27) fell to its lowest level in at least 17 years, raising concerns about its ability to implement budget plans and support economic growth.
